parts: Female born on June 10, 2006. HD: A-A. Shoulder height: 58 cm. ACABE Sociability test: Pending.

A dog from one of Argentina's Top breeders: Patricia Hazán (SPARKLING BEAR'S). She arrived at our home on September 24, 2006. We imported her from Argentina to introduce the best American and English lines into our breeding program.

From the cross of Ch. Zottels Your Sinceraly, litter brother of Zottels You Don't Fool Me, a Top dog in England and son of Flamboyant, with a female descended from Argentina's Top Bobtails (Power Dog Eclipse and Sparkling Bear's Harmony Hill), closely linebred to the English line.

She is a female with a very distinctive, super-compact outline, an outstanding neck and an outstanding back. Her angulation and shoulders are also outstanding. All this is accompanied by free, effortless movement viewed from every angle.

I thank her breeders Patricia and Dante (of the kennel "Sparkling Bear's") for entrusting us with this beautiful female, for their knowledge of OES and for sharing such good times despite the distance.
